assumption: NeRSemble and H3DS are currently under user-side access application and will be provided later; G48 has preconfigured official benchmark intake but no credential-gated data is present yet.

probability_by_scope.reason: G21-G48 already establish real-GT gates, learned-prior local smoke/export, held-out camera geometry diagnostics, and benchmark intake preflight.

probability_by_scope.time_if_pursued_now: 4-8 focused work days if native LAM/Gaussian held-out rendering is feasible; 1-2 weeks if custom renderer work is required
probability_by_scope.reason: G45 geometry is promising, but headline RGB metrics require native camera rendering without similarity/ICP post-alignment.

probability_by_scope.time_after_credentials: 3-7 focused work days for intake and first diagnostic, then 1-2 weeks for method-quality RGB/geometry tables
probability_by_scope.reason: Official tools and gates are preconfigured, but data access, schema surprises, storage, and license/artifact review remain gating risks.

The proposal-level system includes diffusion priors, PanoHead-style 360 modeling, Gaussian rendering, style consistency, structural priors, animation, and robust benchmarks; current work covers the gated benchmark/evaluation foundation.

main_risks: Benchmark access/license delay or redistribution limits.
Native held-out rendering from learned-prior Gaussian outputs may require nontrivial renderer adaptation.
H3DS/NeRSemble schema may not match current Multiface adapter assumptions.
Private/identifiable face artifacts may be disallowed for GitHub publication.
A strong method-quality claim may require comparing against newer feed-forward/head-anchored methods, not only LAM.
decision: All currently possible pre-access benchmark preparation is complete enough to wait for official NeRSemble/H3DS credentials without creating fake benchmark results.
